methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Ark Electronics is a private-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Alex Klimaj. The comparable universe comprises ten peers in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector: one public company (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private firms, including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics among the most prominent.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this valuation. While ten same-sector peers exist, none satisfy the narrower stage-and-tier filters required for reliable triangulation. Specifically, the analysis identified zero same-stage comparables, zero adjacent-stage comparables, and zero similar-valuation-tier matches. Applying an all-sector median would introduce substantial methodological noise and is therefore excluded.

Without sufficient narrow-peer data points, precedent transaction analysis, DCF modeling inputs, or management guidance provided in the dataset, no defensible quantitative valuation range can be derived from the available information. Key uncertainties include the company's current stage, capital raise history, revenue or unit economics, and near-term growth trajectory. Meaningful valuation work on Ark Electronics requires either: expansion of comparable data with stage and scale specificity; disclosure of financial metrics; or forward guidance. Continued diligence should prioritize stage identification and financial performance documentation before quantitative synthesis.
